pet_notes: Preserve the exact existing Mochi Otter identity: cute polished 2D sticker/cartoon brown otter, cream muzzle and belly, teal neckerchief, round face, black expressive eyes, bold clean outline. Add one small whole fish held horizontally directly below the cream belly by both forepaws, centered and physically touching both paws and belly; fish must stay attached and readable at pet size throughout all animation rows and look directions. The fish is smaller than the belly, simple blue-gray with a tiny tail and no text. During waving only, one paw may briefly wave while the fish stays secured against the lower belly by the other paw, then returns to a two-paw hold. No extra props, no scenery, no shadow.
style_notes: Match the existing spritesheet exactly: crisp clean cartoon linework, warm brown fur, cream belly, teal scarf, subtle cel shading. The new fish must use colors distinct from the teal scarf and chroma key.
style_contract: Pet-safe sprite: compact full-body mascot, readable in a 192x208 cell, clear silhouette, simple face, stable palette/materials, and crisp edges for chroma-key extraction.
